cm V25N26E00100E05324E00000EV31E.why: BLOCKS ACCEPTANCE ITEM 6, not an accepted gap. VBRQEXEC/VBRQWAIT end in TC MPAC; NOVAC/FINDVAC/WAITLIST return to MPAC+3 (erasable 0157), where REQUESTC stored TC ENDOFJOB, and no native routine runs that word yet (Lane C, #862 follow-up PR).
